# Berlin Deposit Refund Checklist

A deposit deduction for ordinary wear and tear is usually harder to justify when the flat was returned clean, with only minor scuffs and no real damage. Your goal is to keep the request factual, attach proof, and set a clear deadline for repayment.

## What to Include in Your Refund Request

- **Rental details:** address, lease dates, move-out date, and deposit amount.
- **Short dispute point:** state that the apartment was returned clean and that the remaining marks are normal wear and tear.
- **Handover facts:** mention whether there was a move-out inspection, handover protocol, keys returned, and any comments made at handover.
- **Refund demand:** ask for the full deposit back, or for a written, itemized explanation if they insist on withholding part of it.
- **Deadline:** give a clear payment deadline, usually 14 days.
- **Payment details:** include your bank account/IBAN for the refund.
- **Reservation language:** note that you do not agree to any deduction not supported by evidence or a proper itemized justification.

## Evidence to Attach

- **Move-out photos** showing the condition of the apartment, especially the areas they mention.
- **Move-in photos or inventory report** if you have them, to compare pre-existing condition.
- **Signed handover protocol** or written confirmation from the move-out inspection.
- **Cleaning proof** if available, such as a receipt for professional cleaning or dated cleaning photos.
- **Lease agreement** and any addenda about return condition or deposit terms.
- **Message history** with the landlord or agent about the handover or disputed deduction.
- **A simple photo index** listing each image with date, room, and what it shows.

## Calm but Firm Message Template

### English

Subject: Request for Full Deposit Refund

Dear [Landlord/Property Manager Name],

I am writing regarding the deposit for the apartment at [address]. The tenancy ended on 2026-03-31, and the apartment was returned clean and in good condition. There was no damage beyond minor scuffs consistent with normal wear and tear after a 14-month tenancy.

I do not agree to any deduction for normal wear and tear. If you believe a deduction is justified, please send me a written, itemized explanation with supporting evidence and invoices.

Please transfer the full deposit of [amount] to the following account within 14 days:

[Your name]
[IBAN / account details]

I have attached move-out photos and other relevant documents for your review. Please confirm receipt of this message and the planned refund date.

Kind regards,
[Your full name]

### German

Betreff: Bitte um Rückzahlung der Mietkaution

Sehr geehrte/r [Name des Vermieters / der Hausverwaltung],

ich schreibe Ihnen bezüglich der Mietkaution für die Wohnung in [Adresse]. Das Mietverhältnis endete am 31.03.2026, und die Wohnung wurde sauber und in ordnungsgemäßem Zustand übergeben. Es lagen keine Schäden vor, die über übliche Abnutzungserscheinungen bzw. normale Gebrauchsspuren hinausgehen.

Mit einer Einbehaltung der Kaution wegen normaler Abnutzung bin ich nicht einverstanden. Falls Sie dennoch eine Kürzung für erforderlich halten, bitte ich um eine schriftliche, nachvollziehbare und detaillierte Begründung mit Belegen und Rechnungen.

Bitte überweisen Sie die vollständige Kaution in Höhe von [Betrag] innerhalb von 14 Tagen auf folgendes Konto:

[Ihr Name]
[IBAN / Kontodaten]

Ich habe die Auszugsfotos und weitere relevante Unterlagen beigefügt. Bitte bestätigen Sie den Erhalt dieser Nachricht sowie den geplanten Auszahlungstermin.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
[Ihr vollständiger Name]

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Review Letter] https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bgb/__535.html
Action: [Button: Tenant Advice] https://www.mieterverein-berlin.de/
Action: [Button: Deposit Basics] https://www.verbraucherzentrale.de/wissen/energie/preise-tarife-vertraege/mietkaution-wann-der-vermieter-die-kaution-einbehalten-darf-13718

- German Civil Code, landlord obligations and return of deposit context: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bgb/
- Berlin Tenants’ Association: https://www.mieterverein-berlin.de/
- Consumer advice on rental deposits: https://www.verbraucherzentrale.de/wissen/energie/preise-tarife-vertraege/mietkaution-wann-der-vermieter-die-kaution-einbehalten-darf-13718
